basis: ANNUAL WAGE-TAX WITHHOLDING for Steuerklasse I (identical to IV without children), no church tax, no children, no Freibeträge, employee compulsorily insured in all four social-insurance branches (West ceilings, statutory average Zusatzbeitrag, outside Saxony). This is what the employer withholds over a year under the Programmablaufplan; the income-tax ASSESSMENT (Veranlagung) can differ (actual Werbungskosten, Sonderausgaben, the real Zusatzbeitrag of the Krankenkasse, other income). 'childless' = with the PV childless surcharge (age 23+, no children); 'with_child' = one child (surcharge off, no abatement).

fields.deductions_employee: amounts withheld from the gross wage
fields.employer_contributions: paid by the employer on top of the gross wage (same rates as the employee, except the PV childless surcharge)
fields.per_100_gross: of every 100 EUR gross: how much goes where
fields.intermediate: PAP intermediate values (Vorsorgepauschale, zu versteuernder Jahresbetrag, contribution bases)
